why: Phase C opener rule (#2304, prod 2026-10-13, In Our Time / Curious Cases): the network's pre-roll ad tag is merged into a GUEST's cluster, so the guest is the 'opener'. With one host already seated by name, the opener took the second seat of the two-name pool. It names neither the show nor a stated person, so it stays off the host seats. Pinned role 'unknown' (not 'guest'): nobody introduces this voice by name and two stated experts are unplaced, so the ladder does not guess which one it is -- the point of the scenario is only that it is not a host and never carries the absent host's name.
